source.quote: Third-party sellers ("3P") account for most of the GMV transacted on the Marketplace. We complement this by selling directly to consumers on a first-party basis ("1P") in selected categories where we can enhance price competitiveness and assortment; this accounts for less than 10% of GMV.

salesEnabled.note: The 10-K says GMV includes first-party (1P) sales ("less than 10% of GMV") and states 1P product-sales revenue: "Commerce products sales" of 3,544, defined as revenues from inventory sales and related shipping fees. That stated amount is subtracted, since 1P sales are MercadoLibre's own sales, not third parties'. The 1P GMV is not stated as such; the revenue figure is used as the stated amount. Without the subtraction salesEnabled would be 52.287bn. From Q2 2025 GMV includes food delivery transactions.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001099590-26-000006). Financial-services heavy (Mercado Pago credit): provisions for doubtful accounts (3,091) are non-cash add-backs and loan growth sits in investing (otherNamedItems.loansReceivableChangeInInvesting), so it does not inflate paidOut; growth in funds payable to customers (5,341) does raise operating cash flow and so lowers paidOut. Interest received from investments (584) is inside operating cash flow. Capex is one combined line (property and equipment, intangible assets and intangible assets at fair value).
